summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of a press release announcing the filing of its annual audited financial statements, MD&A, and annual report for the year ended December 31, 2025, along with an application to revoke a management cease trade order. The filing also provides an operational update on its 29% earn-in interest in the M47 block in Turkey, including contingent resource estimates and funding commitments. This is a routine regulatory filing and operational update, not a special situation.
